closeDelay.description:
How long to wait before closing the menu that was opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds.
Requires the openOnHover prop.

delay.description:
How long to wait before the menu may be opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds.
Requires the openOnHover prop.

disabled.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

nativeButton.description: Whether the trigger renders a native <button> element. Set to false when the trigger renders a different element.

openOnHover.description: Whether the menu should also open when the trigger is hovered.

render.description: The element that opens the menu, or a function that returns it. Forward the props and ref to the element. Set visual props, such as color, sx, and variant, on this element.

root.description: Styles applied to the root element.
